observations.statement: For every fixed radius, two disjoint toroidal-grid Tseitin systems with component charge patterns (2,0) and (1,1) have opposite satisfiability and exactly equal translation-normalized rooted signed-incidence signature multisets.
The primal graph of the standard edge-variable Tseitin CNF is exactly the line graph of the underlying graph, independently of the charge vector.
Combining the exact toroidal-grid treewidth 2m-1 with the elementary line-graph transfer yields primal treewidth at least m-1 for each H121 component.

H121 closes the identity-compiler loophole in H118: its input primal treewidth is Omega(sqrt(N)), but no theorem yet forces an arbitrary fixed-pass low-treewidth output to forget component charge parity.
H116's implication to SAT not in P/poly fails because its formula-length exponent may depend on the circuit exponent k while the attacked budget remains n^k.
H124 repairs the implication by using the same actual formula length L for generation, legal encodings, and the L^k circuit budget.
Witness-cover pressure survives the repair only after every size term is rewritten in L; semantic compression beyond hardwired witnesses remains the direct circuit-lower-bound wall.
After C018 the expected inventory is 107 live hypotheses and 17 terminal historical nodes; these counts are bookkeeping rather than a completion percentage.
